chapter.summary: Rory pitches his houseplant-negotiation AI to strangers at a high-top, dragging a reluctant Jun in as 'CTO,' and the pitch spirals into absurdity. Nadia overhears, asks one devastating question, and books him for the midnight lightning demo, leaving Rory with a fern, a tape-wrapped sensor and no product.

shots.frame: Crowded rooftop party at dusk, string lights glowing, Rory at a high-top table with a potted fern, three strangers holding drinks
shots.motion: Handheld push-in as Rory spreads his arms wide

line.speaker: rory
line.text: We're building agentic infrastructure for plants. The last untapped user base.

shots.frame: Close-up of the fern on the table, a small soil sensor visibly wrapped in silver tape stuck in the dirt
shots.motion: Slow push-in as a tiny green light blinks once
shots.sound: Faint electronic beep under party noise

line.speaker: rory
line.text: Our fern-first LLM lets photosynthesis talk directly to your landlord.

shots.frame: Two strangers at the table nodding seriously, one typing notes on a phone
shots.motion: Quick push-in on their blank, nodding faces

line.speaker: rory
line.text: Think of it as a chlorophyll-native agent swarm. Pre-seed, post-soil.

shots.frame: Jun walking past with a paper plate of dumplings, Rory grabbing his hoodie sleeve
shots.motion: Rory yanks Jun into frame, camera whips to follow

line.speaker: rory
line.text: And this is our CTO, Jun. He architected the root layer.

shots.frame: Jun deadpan, mouth full of dumpling, staring at the strangers
shots.motion: Slow push-in as he chews and sighs

line.speaker: jun
line.text: Yes. The roots. Very scalable. Downward, mostly.

shots.frame: Behind Rory, Nadia in a black blazer lowering her sparkling water, eyebrow raised
shots.motion: Rack focus from Rory's back to Nadia

shots.frame: Nadia stepping up to the high-top, strangers parting nervously
shots.motion: Nadia sets her glass down beside the fern, camera low angle

line.speaker: nadia
line.text: Does the fern have traction, or does it have a pot?

shots.frame: Rory frozen mid-gesture, sweat bead on his temple, grin cracking
shots.motion: Snappy push-in on his panicking eyes

line.speaker: rory
line.text: We're seeing incredible organic growth. Literally. It grew.

shots.frame: Nadia's phone screen lighting up with a call from 'Partners - URGENT', her thumb declining it
shots.motion: Quick insert as she swipes it away

line.speaker: nadia
line.text: Midnight. Lightning demo. Show me the fern negotiating.

shots.frame: Rory and Jun alone at the table with the fern, Nadia walking away into the crowd, clock on a nearby screen reading 8:04
shots.motion: Jun slowly turns to Rory, camera pushes in, Rory glances at camera
shots.sound: Party noise swelling back, a clock tick

line.speaker: jun
line.text: So. When does the fern learn to talk?
